card.title: Nintendo Switch Error codes: 2107-0445 and 2110-1115 Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Error codes: 2107-0445 and 2110-1115 Repair

claims.statement: Switch errors 2107-0445 and 2110-1115 are fixed by replacing the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth chip; reflow/reball is not always successful.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
